name: desktop-agent
description: Filamap Desktop Agent for Bambu Lab A1

scripts.package-exe: tsc && pkg dist/index.js --targets node22-win-x64 --output filamap-agent.exe && if not exist bambu-bridge\\filamap-bambu-bridge.exe (echo ERROR: bambu-bridge\\filamap-bambu-bridge.exe nao encontrado. & exit /b 1) && if not exist installer\\payload mkdir installer\\payload && if not exist installer\\payload\\bambu-bridge mkdir installer\\payload\\bambu-bridge && copy /Y filamap-agent.exe installer\\payload\\filamap-agent.exe && copy /Y run-agent.vbs installer\\payload\\run-agent.vbs && copy /Y start-agent.vbs installer\\payload\\start-agent.vbs && copy /Y install-autostart.ps1 installer\\payload\\install-autostart.ps1 && copy /Y uninstall-autostart.ps1 installer\\payload\\uninstall-autostart.ps1 && copy /Y bambu-bridge\\filamap-bambu-bridge.exe installer\\payload\\bambu-bridge\\filamap-bambu-bridge.exe
scripts.test: tsc && node --test dist/consumption.test.js dist/networkRediscovery.test.js dist/config/configStore.test.js dist/config/secretStore.test.js dist/config/dpapiSecretStore.test.js dist/config/onboarding.test.js dist/filamentProfileSync.test.js dist/bambuCloudSpoolSync.test.js
